title: maint.ack.v1
description: Phase 8 §8.1 — Per-consumer acknowledgement of a maint.event.v1 envelope. Producer set: any registered consumer of maint.event.v1 (boundary test enforces). Consumer set: ops_console only — agents do not read each others' acks. Schema-version 1; field additions are minor bumps. Per-consumer semantics: every consumer that processes a maint.event.v1{request_id} publishes EXACTLY ONE maint.ack.v1 carrying its own accepted_by. Re-deliveries published by the bus do not produce additional acks (consumer idempotency ledger collapses dupes; ack.attempt > 1 is reserved for explicit consumer-driven retries).

request_id.description: Echoed from the maint.event.v1 payload (NOT the envelope) — the operator's correlator.

accepted.description: True when the consumer reached a terminal state (success OR no-op idempotent skip). False only on hard rejection (e.g. unknown subject, invalid arguments).

accepted_by.description: Consumer agent id (e.g. 'sec.rate.v1', 'storage.v1'). The publisher's wait-for-acks loop matches this against the expected ack set computed from the kind→consumer routing map at publish-time.

details.description: Optional flat key/value bag, ≤ cfg.maint_ack_details_max_bytes (default 2048). No nested arrays of objects (cardinality control). Consumer-defined contents.

processed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of consumer's terminal-state decision.

attempt.description: Per-consumer attempt counter. 1 is the steady state. >1 indicates an explicit consumer-driven retry (NOT a bus-level redelivery — those are absorbed by the consumer's idempotency ledger and do NOT publish a new ack).
